translation_snapshot.source: These voratun gauntlets shine brightly beneath a thin layer of wear. Originally used in the spellhunt, they were often used to destroy arcane artifacts, ridding the world of their influence.
translation_snapshot.target: 这件沃瑞钽臂铠虽然有一些使用痕迹，仍然闪耀着光芒。它起源于魔法狩猎时期，用于摧毁奥术类装备，以惩罚法师们对这个世界的暴行。
